# Embedded Emissions: Cannot Be Calculated

**I can't calculate a value because the CN code is missing.**

## Input Check

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | "a steel product" | ❌ Missing |
| (b) Country of production | China | ✅ In table |
| (c) Quantity | 500 t | ✅ Provided |

The SEE depends on both the CN code and the country. "Steel product" matches several codes in the table, and their China SEEs differ by almost a factor of two. The ruleset says not to estimate when an input is missing.

## Possible Results Once the CN Code Is Confirmed

These figures are for reference only. None is the declared result.

| CN code | Good | SEE, China (tCO2e/t) | × 500 t |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, iron/non-alloy steel | 1.74 | 870.00 tCO2e |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products, iron/non-alloy steel | 3.314 | 1,657.00 tCO2e |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, with indentations (rebar) | 3.169 | 1,584.50 tCO2e |

Note: 7201 (pig iron, China: 1.66 → 830.00 tCO2e) is not a steel product. It would apply only if the good is actually pig iron.
